goal: Fix status printing undefined for the last event when it is a message
spec: BUG: status at tools/muster.mjs:825 builds the last-event label from last.agent, but a message event is logged as {event: msg, from, to} with no agent field, so every task whose last event is a message prints 'undefined:msg'. Visible today as '[001] UNCLAIMED | Last: undefined:msg'.
